{{Quote|You're an Imperial Missionary!''"<br />"''Yes. And so are you, by your garb. My name is ''Ethan Adare''.|Deliah Blue and Ethan Adare|<ref name="Legacy 38" />}}
'''Ethan Adare''' served the [[Imperial Mission]], an organization dedicated to the [[Fel Empire]]'s "[[Victory Without War]]" program, on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. In [[137 ABY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] met the [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Deliah Blue]]&mdash;who was pretending to be the Imperial Missionary [[Astraal Vao]]&mdash;as she was attempting to locate a [[Trivalve assembly/Legends|trivalve assembly]], which was essential for repairing her crew's [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']]. After visiting the local Imperial Mission's house, Adare provided Blue with the trivalve assembly, despite knowing that she was lying about her identity. After Blue eventually revealed her true identity, Adare helped her install the trivalve assembly on the ''Mynock''.

==Biography==
{{Quote|We at the Imperial Mission are not the face of the ''Sith'' Empire&hellip;not yet anyway. You need to get that trivalve installed. Want some help?''"<br />"''Uh&hellip;no offense, Ethan, but this is a drive on a spaceship, not a speeder.''"<br />"''I wasn't ''born'' an Imperial Missionary. Let's get this thing onto your ship, shall we?|Adare and Deliah Blue|<ref name="Legacy 40">[[Legacy (2006) 40|''Legacy'' (2006) 40]]</ref>}}
[[File:Imperial_Mission_Duty.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ethan Adare served the Imperial Mission's house on Tatooine.]]
Ethan Adare was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Fel Empire]] as a representative of the [[Imperial Mission]], which was designed to promote [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]'s "[[Victory Without War]]" initiative, in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to the [[Sith–Imperial War]].<ref name="Legacy 38" /> In [[130 ABY]], at the end of the war, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]] [[Attack on Emperor Fel|seized the Imperial throne]] from Fel.<ref name="Legacy 2006 1">[[Legacy (2006) 1|''Legacy'' (2006) 1]]</ref> Adare continued to serve the Imperial Mission as a part of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Krayt's Empire]] and by [[137 ABY]] was assigned to the Imperial Mission's station on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="Legacy 38" />

In that same year, Adare met the [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[Deliah Blue]]&mdash;who was pretending to be an Imperial Missionary in order to find a [[Trivalve assembly/Legends|trivalve assembly]] needed to fix her crew's [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']]&mdash;in Mos Eisley. She introduced herself to Adare as "[[Astraal Vao]]" and asked where the local mission house was.<ref name="Legacy 38" /> Despite knowing that Blue was lying about her identity due to a previous meeting with Vao,<ref name="Legacy 40" /> Adare offered to take her there. On the way, she claimed that a [[Farm/Legends|farmer]] who had helped her needed a new trivalve assembly for his [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. After they arrived at the mission house, Blue listened to Adare's views on the local Imperial Mission and the organization's role in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], but she reminded Adare that the farmer needed the trivalve assembly.<ref name="Legacy 38" /> Adare retrieved the part and traveled with Blue to Mos Eisley's [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="Legacy 40" />

After arriving at the ''Mynock''{{'s}} location in the spaceport, Adare was held at [[Blaster/Legends|gunpoint]] by Blue, who instructed the Human to give her the trivalve assembly and leave the spaceport. However, Adare hinted at alerting the local authorities and suggested that [[Death/Legends|death]] was the only way to ensure the Imperial Missionary's silence. When Blue grew frustrated, Adare told her that she was not really Astraal Vao. She revealed her true identity to Adare and began weeping over the fact that her inability to install the trivalve assembly would lead to the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate finding and killing [[Cade Skywalker]] and [[Jariah Syn]], two of her friends. After hearing this, Adare gave her the part for the ''Mynock'', stating that she should have asked for assistance in the beginning. The Missionary then offered help in installing the trivalve assembly on the ''Mynock'', much to Blue's surprise. With Adare's assistance, Blue was able to successfully repair the ''Mynock'' and leave Tatooine.<ref name="Legacy 40" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Nobody gives away anything for nothing. Especially not the Empire&mdash;not to a pirate like me!"''<br />"''You have more worth than you think, Deliah Blue.|Deliah Blue and Adare|<ref name="Legacy 40" />}}
[[File:MissionaryBlue.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Ethan Adare gave Deliah Blue the parts needed to fix the ''Mynock''.]]
As an Imperial Missionary, Ethan Adare believed in the principles of the organization,<ref name="Legacy 38" /><ref name="Legacy 40" /> which operated on [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Roan Fel's "Victory Without War" initiative.<ref name="LE CG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Adare believed that the [[One Sith|Sith]]&ndash;Imperials would have ceased the Imperial Mission's funding if not for [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Konrad Rus]]'s belief in the organization.<ref name="Legacy 38" /> Despite knowing that Deliah Blue was lying about her identity, Adare still assisted her in locating a trivalve assembly. After she revealed her true identity and began degrading herself, the Missionary made it a point to tell her that she was not worthless and offered further assistance in installing the trivalve assembly aboard the ''Mynock'', despite having been held at gunpoint by Blue moments before.<ref name="Legacy 40" /> Adare had long [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Hair/Legends|locs]], a full beard and mustache, and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and skin.<ref name="Legacy 38" />

==Equipment==
While operating as an Imperial Missionary, he wore a set of robes typically worn by Imperial missionaries.<ref name="Legacy 38" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ethan Adare first appeared in the [[Legacy (2006) 38|thirty-eighth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series. The issue was by [[John Ostrander]], drawn by [[Jan Duursema]],<ref name="Legacy 38" /> and released on [[July 29]], [[2009]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54410/star_wars_legacy_2006_38|text=Star Wars: Legacy (2006) #38}}</ref>
